notes: Pay stations: one coin and bill box at the counter for the whole shop. The customer picks an account or a PC on the station and pays; the counter prices it from the rate card and credits it. Let a new station in and see its latest payments under Settings > Computers and accounts > Pay stations; a payment that could not be delivered (PC off, licence hold, past the time limit) stays red until marked settled. Books shows station payments as their own kind. Goes with client 1.64.0.
